_comment: Canonical execution result and request payload shapes. ExecutionRequestPayload is the wire payload for command execution requests. ExecutionResultsPayload is the wire payload for command execution results. Serialized from ExecutionRequestPayload and ExecutionResultsPayload (internal/models/commands.go).

execution_request_payload._description: Wire payload for command execution requests.

task_id.description: Task ID. Omitted when not set.

environment.description: Environment variable overrides (key-value pairs). Omitted when empty.

working_directory.description: Working directory for execution. Omitted when not set.

network_topology_id.description: Network topology ID. Omitted when not set.

target_address.description: Target address. Omitted when not set.

tags.description: Execution tags (key-value pairs). Omitted when empty.

execution_results_payload._description: Wire payload for command execution results. Uses pointer types for optional fields.

task_id.description: Task ID. Omitted when not set.

status.description: Execution status. Values: EXECUTION_STATUS_EXECUTING, EXECUTION_STATUS_COMPLETED, EXECUTION_STATUS_FAILED.

operator_id.description: Operator ID that executed the command

stdout_hash.description: SHA256 hash of stdout. Omitted when empty.

stderr_hash.description: SHA256 hash of stderr. Omitted when empty.

stored_locally.description: Whether output was stored locally on the Operator

return_code.description: Process return code. Omitted when zero.

error_message.description: Error message. Omitted when not set.

error_type.description: Error type. Omitted when not set.

start_time.description: Execution start time. Omitted when not set.

end_time.description: Execution end time. Omitted when not set.

terminal_output.description: Terminal output details. Conforms to terminal_output.json#terminal_output. Omitted when not set.

system_info.description: Execution system info. Conforms to terminal_output.json#execution_system_info. Omitted when not set.

environment_info.description: Execution environment info. Conforms to terminal_output.json#execution_environment_info. Omitted when not set.
